results.title: Ramsey ultrafilter
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An ultrafilter $U$ on $\mathbb{N}$ is *Ramsey* if for every sequence $(A_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of pairwise disjoint subsets of $\mathbb{N}$ whose union is $\mathbb{N}$ and such that $A_n \notin U$ for all $n$, there is $X \in U$ such that $X \cap A_n$ has at most one element for every $n$.

results.title: Δ-system
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A family $A$ of subsets of a type $\alpha$ is a Δ-system with root $r \subseteq \alpha$ if $s \cap t = r$ for any two distinct members $s$ and $t$ of $A$.

results.title: Breadth of an element
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, $p$ a natural number and $g \in G$, and write $g^G$ for the conjugacy class of $g$. When $p \ge 2$, the breadth $\operatorname{br}_p(g)$ of $g$ is $\lfloor \log_p |g^G| \rfloor$, the largest natural number $k$ with $p^k \le |g^G|$; when $p \le 1$, it is $0$.

results.title: Breadth of a finite group
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a finite group $G$ and a natural number $p$, the breadth $\operatorname{br}_p(G)$ of $G$ is the maximum of the element breadths $\operatorname{br}_p(g)$ over all $g \in G$.

results.title: Conjugacy class sizes divide the group order

results.title: Conjugacy classes of a finite $p$-group have $p$-power size

results.title: The (-r)-Fibonacci polynomials
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r$ a natural number, $x \in A$ and $y$ a unit of $A$. The values $U_n = U^{(-r)}_n(x, y) \in A$ of the $(-r)$-Fibonacci polynomials are defined for $n \ge 0$ by $U_0 = 0$, $U_1 = 1$, $U_n = 0$ for $2 \le n \le r$, and, when $r \ge 1$, $U_{n+1} = y^{-1} U_{n-r+1} - y^{-1} x U_{n-r}$ for $n \ge r$. results.title: Rising sun set
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For real numbers $a, b$ and a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, the rising sun set of $f$ on $(a, b)$ is the set of points $x \in (a, b)$ for which there is some $t$ with $x < t \le b$ and $f(x) < f(t)$.

results.title: Rising sun decomposition
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A set $E \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ has a rising sun decomposition for a function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ if there are sequences $(c_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ and $(d_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of real numbers such that $E$ is the union of the open intervals $(c_n, d_n)$, these intervals are pairwise disjoint, and $f(c_n) \le f(d_n)$ for every $n$.

results.title: Rising sun property
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $a, b$ be real numbers, let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, and let $S$ be the rising sun set of $f$ on $(a, b)$. Then $f$ has the rising sun property on $[a, b]$ if $S$ is open, $S$ is empty if and only if $f$ is antitone (non-increasing) on $[a, b]$, and, whenever $S$ is nonempty, $S$ has a rising sun decomposition for $f$.

results.title: Riesz's rising sun lemma
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $a < b$ be real numbers and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be continuous on $[a, b]$. Then $f$ has the rising sun property on $[a, b]$.

results.title: Latent causal variable model
results.caption: Structure
results.summary: The latent causal variable model of O'Connor and Price (2018, Equation 3) on a probability space: `α_k = q_k π + γ_k` with `π` independent of `(γ₁, γ₂)`, the law of `(γ₁, γ₂)` invariant under each sign flip, `π` of mean zero and unit variance, and both `α_k` of unit second moment. Fourth moments are assumed finite.

results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The marginal effect `α₂ = q₂ π + γ₂` on trait 2.

results.title: Excess kurtosis of the latent effect
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The excess kurtosis `κ_π = E(π⁴) - 3` of the effect on the latent variable.

results.title: Genetic correlation in the latent causal variable model
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The genetic correlation is `E(α₁ α₂) = q₁ q₂` (O'Connor and Price 2018, after Equation 1).

results.title: Mixed fourth moment
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Mixed fourth moment (O'Connor and Price 2018, Equation 2): `E(α₁³ α₂) = κ_π q₁³ q₂ + 3 q₁ q₂`.

results.title: Mixed fourth moment $E(\alpha_1 \alpha_2^3)$
results.caption: Theorem

results.title: Mediated coefficient of the second trait is at most one in size

results.title: Fourth moment of the latent effect is at least one
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `E(π⁴) ≥ (E π²)² = 1`, so the excess kurtosis is at least `-2`.

results.title: Genetic causality proportion
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The genetic causality proportion `gcp = (log|q₂| - log|q₁|) / (log|q₂| + log|q₁|)` (O'Connor and Price 2018, Equation 4). Meaningful for `0 < |q₁|, |q₂| ≤ 1` and `ρ_g² < 1`; for `|q₁| = |q₂| = 1` the denominator vanishes and the value is `0` by the convention `x / 0 = 0`.

results.title: Sign of the genetic causality proportion
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `gcp ≥ 0` iff `q₂² ≤ q₁²`, for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² = (q₁ q₂)² < 1`.

results.title: Genetic causality proportion solves the defining equation
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The genetic causality proportion solves the paper's Equation 1: `q₂² / q₁² = (ρ_g²) ^ gcp` with `ρ_g = q₁ q₂`, for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`.

results.title: Genetic causality proportion is at most 1
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `gcp ≤ 1` when `q₁² ≤ 1` (for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`).

results.title: Genetic causality proportion is at least −1
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: `-1 ≤ gcp` when `q₂² ≤ 1` (for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`).

results.title: The paper's criterion for `gcp ≥ 0`
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The paper's criterion for `gcp ≥ 0` (O'Connor and Price 2018, after Equation 2), under the sign condition `κ_π > 0` that it needs: if `ρ_g ≠ 0`, `ρ_g² < 1` and `|E(α₁ α₂³)| ≤ |E(α₁³ α₂)|`, then `gcp ≥ 0`.
